other.name: U.S. Election Assistance Commission - State election office directory (use it to find the official state and county election office)

gates.basis: Most restrictive behavior. Used when rules/<state>.json is missing, fails schema validation, or a field is null. Jury non-qualification records are treated as confidential (LEGAL-REVIEW.md: 'Unverified: non-juror list confidentiality outside NY and NC. Default to confidential.'). Output is counts only. No names leave the page.

notes: Every null in this file means: the strict default applies.
The federal NVRA 90-day rule (52 U.S.C. 20507(c)(2)(A)) always applies. For the November 3, 2026 general election the window began August 5, 2026.
A private person may still refer concerns about the official process (aggregate counts only) to the state election office found through the EAC directory.
